name: Sentura Cost Tracking
description: Per-agent and per-department LLM cost attribution. Subscribes to OpenClaw's `model.usage` diagnostic event and persists every LLM call's token counts, model, latency, and pre-computed costUsd to a rolling JSONL store. Exposes `sentura.cost.events`, `sentura.cost.summary`, and `sentura.cost.byUser` gateway RPCs for the dashboard's Cost Center page.

logDir.description: Directory for cost-event JSONL files. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/sentura-cost/

maxAgeDays.description: Maximum age in days before old daily files are pruned
